input_policy: Only the original raw text edge list is used to construct and check the graph; no author CSR/ball/provider cache is read.

source.diameter_premise: The source graph's already accepted D <= 5 is inherited; no source all-root BFS is rerun here.

construction.operation: Retain every original edge; append vertex 42402 and exactly its 12 specified incident edges.

deterministic_farthest_witness.shortestness: The complete BFS assigns the endpoint this distance.

all_pairs_conclusion.proof: Every old-old pair retains a length <= 5 path from the accepted source because all original edges are retained. The single complete BFS from vertex 42402 reaches every old vertex within 5. These cases cover every vertex pair; the BFS witness at distance 5 also gives the matching lower bound.

root_graph_comparison.comparison: exact undirected edge-set equality against independent raw-source reconstruction

reproduction.algorithm: Parse raw source into a simple undirected edge set; union exactly the 12 fixed new edges; sort all adjacency lists; one FIFO BFS from 42402; choose the smallest-index farthest endpoint.
